'''Anakin's Lightsaber''' is a [[persona]]: every card that represents this weapon counts as the same weapon, whatever its title, and each player may have only one card of a persona on the table at a time.<ref name="ar2023">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Players Committee Advanced Rulebook] (2023), Chapter 5, Personas, and Appendix D, Persona Lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192915/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The 8 card pages of the Anakin's Lightsaber persona fall under 2 card titles, listed below in release order (Decipher cards first, then the Players Committee's Virtual cards).

May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value. Anakin's Lightsaber is a matching weapon for any persona of a Skwalker, such as Luke or Leia, that meets the deploy conditions. It may only deploy upon Vader if he has "crossed over" to the Light Side, once again answering to the name of Anakin.
